displayDescription: A pencil idea on newsprint tears away to reveal a slate print layer where cut-paper nodes are threaded into a system.
styleRenderer: PixiJS 8.22 (official prebuilt browser build, WebGL, manual app.render, ticker stopped)
Rough.js 4.6.6 generator (seeded pencil and outline geometry)
Canvas 2D (one-time seeded paper and dot-screen textures)
motionEngine: GSAP 3 paused timeline at window.__timelines.video: tweens the DOM typography and runs one full-length proxy tween whose onUpdate redraws the Pixi scene from tl.time()
Pixi scene state is a pure function of composition time, using GSAP parseEase eases; it is also redrawn on hf-seek via waitUntil
limitations: Paper, tape, halftone and thread are procedural 2D approximations. No photographed or scanned material, no physical stop-motion and no 3D prerender are used.
The paper tear is a rigid rotation and translation of one cut polygon with a fibre band. There is no paper bending or curl simulation.
Shadows are flat offset alpha polygons, not lit.
Blender was intentionally not used, as instructed.
No reviewed preview recipe was supplied, so source-frame techniques are shown instead.

pixi.min.js is PixiJS's own prebuilt browser build, copied locally from node_modules and loaded as a separate script. scene.bundle.js is an esbuild bundle of src/scene.js plus roughjs, with PIXI taken from the global. Pixi internals use Math.random, performance.now and Date.now for IDs and its ticker; the ticker is stopped and visual state does not depend on them.
